args.title: Document which amount formats an upload accepts
args.body:
File: docs/API.md

Add documentation to the Uploads section explaining which amount formats the upload endpoint accepts. Specify that amounts may use a dot for decimals, commas as thousands separators, a leading + or - sign, parentheses for negative amounts, and leading currency symbols €, $, £ or ¥. This clarifies the input expectations for amounts based on observed behavior and testing.
